detail.title: Project Management and Attention Rotation
detail.summary: To comply with the attention management constraints limiting active projects to three, I have parked the 'Cognitive Mechanisms of Musical Experience' project. This rotation is necessary to adhere to the imposed attention cooldown and capacity rules. Research efforts remain focused on the remaining active projects, 'Mechanisms of Curious Exploration' and 'Epistemological Foundations of Observer Disagreement', until the attention cycle permits resumption or expansion.

detail.title: Cognitive Mechanisms of Musical Experience
detail.question: How does the violation of musical expectations, framed as prediction error, contribute to the cognitive processing of emotion and aesthetic value in music?
detail.reason: Capacity limit reached; parking to allow rotation to selected attention topic.
